verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec for the Box API. The probe found 404s at every standard OpenAPI/Swagger path, and the docs cover only a human-readable reference and an llms.txt docs index, which is an adjacent artifact rather than an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
